faqs.a: Yes, cyclists can use a crosswalk if a bike lane doesn’t extend through an intersection, if you’re unsure how to make a left turn without a two-stage turn box, or if you simply feel more comfortable. Be sure to dismount and walk your bike through the crosswalk like a pedestrian. Once you’re through the intersection, ensure it’s safe to re-enter the roadway.
